description.value: Axum Ethiopian Restaurant serves traditional Ethiopian cuisine — spiced stews, injera-based communal plates, and a robust vegetarian selection — from its East Hastings Street location in Vancouver. The restaurant offers full sit-down dining alongside online ordering, private event hosting, and catering packages for all occasions. It is a lively neighborhood destination known for both hearty meat dishes and a wide range of entirely plant-based options.
